# The Recoverable Minimum

Far-future narrative about an unresolved preservation operation.
Not documentation. Not a policy proposal. Not a character novel.

This work may be used as a problem set or read as a completed form.
Neither use is prior.

- [Act I](narrative/act-i.md)
- then [Act II](narrative/act-ii.md)
- then [Act III](narrative/act-iii.md)

No extraction is required for the contact to be valid.

The instrumental path is a valid reduction. It is not the only valid contact.
